column2: set_execution_mode(Compiled) enables lane methods, then the startup-snapshot restore replaces ProgramStore and resets js_jit_lane_methods_enabled to tiers.stress (false); every AOT image and every --u-jit run has lane bodies off
column3: ENABLE_LANES printed once, then js_tier_may_claim saw lane_methods=false for every function (fn 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, ...), ahead=true, exec=Compiled

column2: js_tier_may_claim returned early on `tier_may_run` before the ahead-image check, so the AArch64 policy's js_function_tiers=false also blocked image bodies
column3: compiled.rs js_tier_may_claim: moved the ahead-image check before the policy gate

column2: with the store fix, ahead lane bodies install and run: simple loops and inlined callees are exact
a callee whose body contains a loop (or a switch with cases) faults inside the region's step helper: body_general_step's payload word is read from a non-lane context
column3: STEP_ARGS vm=0x6 residual=0x3 context=0x7ffd000000000001 pc=0x7ffd000000000001 (v2/s2.js); c1.js (callee with a 3-trip loop) STEP_ARGS vm=0x6 residual=0x4, exit 139

column2: a callee with no loop and no switch is exact (inlined, chained, try/catch)

loop regions run with the lane context as their CallContext (`code.run(..., (cx as usize, ...))`); an ahead activation's rows read payload = [ctx + CALL_CONTEXT_ADAPTER_PAYLOAD] and get the LoopEntry's words (6, 3 = guard masks) instead
column3: dispatch_fast.rs region_run_in_lane 8852-8870; the observed payload words are the entry masks
